description: A voltage-controlled amplifier with a manual level knob and a switch between linear and exponential response

params.text: Sets the gain, 0 to 100 per cent, which the control voltage then scales
Chooses the response, L applying the level as it reads and E raising it to the fourth power so the lower part of the dial is far quieter

inputs.text: The signal to be amplified, taken with all its polyphonic channels
Scales the gain, 0V for silence and 10V for whatever LEVEL is set to; more than 10V does nothing further and a negative voltage silences the output

outputs.text: The amplified signal, with as many channels as the signal input

notes: with nothing patched to CV the LEVEL knob alone sets the gain, and the module comes up fully open
bypassing the module passes the signal input straight to the output in place of silencing it

inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads gain left to the LEVEL knob; a negative voltage does nothing here.
